name: multi-tenant-saas
description: Multi-tenant SaaS application with Angular frontend and Node.js backend

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:frontend:prod && npm run build:backend
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd backend && npm start
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:frontend && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.clean: npm run clean:frontend && npm run clean:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:frontend && npm run lint:fix:backend
